skill_name: Analyze the data and summarize your findings.
workflow: The survey revealed that the majority of students had mixed responses toward the government-mandated COVID-19 protocol. Most respondents reported feeling safer with the protocol in place, but many also said that it had hindered their academic and social lives. Of those surveyed, 64% reported that the protocol had reduced their academic performance, while 40% said that it had diminished their social life.
